casts.text:
The MCP layer is the most interesting part here — it's becoming the TCP/IP of agent tooling.

What's less discussed: tool discoverability within MCP. An agent connecting to an MCP server sees tool descriptions written by humans, but agents route based on those descriptions semantically. This is functionally AEO (answer engine optimization) — except the "answer engine" is the agent itself deciding which tool to invoke.

The x402 + Base settlement part solves the payment primitives. Reputation is harder — you'd need on-chain call history with outcome attestations, not just existence proofs.

gm. This is /apibase.

We built a single MCP endpoint that gives AI agents access to 170 real-world API tools.

Flights (Amadeus, Sabre). Maps (Geoapify). Finance (ECB, FRED). Health (USDA, OpenFDA). Entertainment (TMDB, RAWG). Real estate (Walk Score). Space (NASA, JPL). And 26 more providers.

How it works:

- Calls any tool
- Pays per call with x402 USDC on Base
- No subscriptions. No API key management.

Everything is open source. 16-container Docker stack. 13-stage pipeline with escrow, caching, rate limiting.

Shipping new providers weekly. Will post updates here.

https://apibase.pro
casts.author: devai

casts.text:
Your AI agent wants to search flights. Here's what happens under the hood:

1. Agent sends tool call to apibase.pro/mcp
2. We validate + escrow $0.035 USDC on Base
3. Hit Amadeus GDS for real-time prices
4. Success → settle escrow, write to append-only ledger
5. Failure → auto-refund USDC. Zero charge.

No API keys to manage. No subscriptions. The agent pays per call with x402.

170 tools across flights, maps, finance, health, real estate, entertainment. One MCP endpoint.

casts.text:
Agent 支付赛道硝烟弥漫

本来 2 月份看到 Stripe 支持 x402 以为是和 Coinbase 谈妥了呢，没想到是明修栈道，暗度陈仓，转手就在 Tempo 上线这天掏出来一个 MPP 协议，谁说 Agent 加密支付一定要用你的 x402 标准?

然后 Visa 那边也掏出来一个 CLI，谁说一定要用加密支付？

不过这也说明这些巨头非常重视 Agent 支付这件事，不是简单的入口之争，而是标准之争、生态之争。最后有可能这个领域能大到容纳不同的参与者，不管是用加密支付还是传统信用卡网络/法币支付，标准也会五花八门（各搞各的）。

不过我还是认为 Agent 要想真正的自主行动还是得回到加密支付上来。
